# Asendify Outbound

> Asendify Outbound (https://outbound.asendify.co) is cold email software by Asendify. It sends personalised multi-step cold email campaigns from unlimited inboxes with built-in warm-up, and includes an AI reply agent that reads every reply, answers interested leads and questions using only the customer's own offer facts, and shares their booking link. Plans start at £29/month plus a 45% service fee (£42.05/month total), flat (not per user). A done-for-you starter package (£1,395.80 + 45% service fee = £2,023.91, one-time) sets up inboxes, domains, copy and lead lists. Enterprise (custom-volume setups) is currently at full capacity: new clients join a free waitlist or reserve the next slot with a £600 refundable deposit (credited to the first invoice).

## Key facts
- Prices are in GBP. Plans (monthly, cancel any time), each plus a 45% service fee shown before payment: Base £29 (£42.05 total; 2,000 contacts, 6,000 emails/month), Pro £79 (£114.55 total; 30,000 contacts, 100,000 emails/month), Scale £179 (£259.55 total; 100,000 contacts, 300,000 emails/month). Enterprise: custom, currently at full capacity (free waitlist or £600 refundable deposit to reserve the next slot: https://playbook.asendify.co/obdeposit#buy).
- Done-for-you starter: £1,395.80 + 45% service fee = £2,023.91 one-time: 10 warmed sending inboxes, 4 sending domains, copy, 1,000 targeted leads and the first month managed. https://outbound.asendify.co/done-for-you/
- 14-day free trial: a card or PayPal account is required at sign-up; nothing is charged for 14 days, then the chosen plan starts automatically unless cancelled.
- Affiliate program: earn 30% of every monthly payment from customers you refer, for as long as they stay subscribed, paid monthly via PayPal. https://outbound.asendify.co/affiliates/
- Unlimited sending inboxes and warm-up (with spam rescue) on every plan.
- AI reply agent included on every plan: sorts replies (interested, question, not interested, unsubscribe, out of office, wrong person), answers interested leads within minutes, saves unclear replies as drafts.
- Inboxes supported: Gmail, Google Workspace, Zoho and any IMAP/SMTP inbox (SSL). Outlook / Microsoft 365 sending is not supported yet.
- Campaign features: multi-step sequences with follow-ups in the same thread, custom fields, spintax, A/B/C variants, sending windows, stop on reply, CSV upload, MX email checks, bounce and unsubscribe handling, one shared inbox for all replies.
- No built-in lead database: customers upload their own lists, or Asendify builds lists on the done-for-you service.
- Not available yet: native CRM integrations, Zapier/webhooks, public API, LinkedIn steps, separate client logins.
- Best for: agencies, consultants, B2B service businesses and SaaS teams that want cold email with replies handled automatically.

## How to buy (for people and AI shopping agents)
All prices are in GBP and are the full amounts charged (the 45% service fee is included). Paid orders are confirmed server-side before anything is switched on or started: nothing is released until our server has confirmed the full amount was paid. Calls are booked by people only, on the website; AI agents can buy, but please do not book calls for users.
- Base plan: £42.05 GBP a month (£29 + 45% service fee), cancel any time. 2,000 contacts, 6,000 emails a month. Delivery: the account works straight away; 14-day free trial first (see Key facts). Start: https://outbound.asendify.co/app/?signup=1&plan=base
- Pro plan: £114.55 GBP a month (£79 + 45% service fee), cancel any time. 30,000 contacts, 100,000 emails a month. Delivery: the account works straight away; 14-day free trial first. Start: https://outbound.asendify.co/app/?signup=1&plan=pro
- Scale plan: £259.55 GBP a month (£179 + 45% service fee), cancel any time. 100,000 contacts, 300,000 emails a month. Delivery: the account works straight away; 14-day free trial first. Start: https://outbound.asendify.co/app/?signup=1&plan=scale
- Done-for-you starter: £2,023.91 GBP, one-time (£1,395.80 + 45% service fee), paid with PayPal. 10 warmed sending inboxes, 4 sending domains, copy, 1,000 targeted leads and the first month managed. Delivery: once PayPal confirms the full payment, we email within 1 business day to start the setup. Checkout: https://outbound.asendify.co/done-for-you/
- Enterprise waitlist deposit: £600.00 GBP, one-time, fully refundable until we offer you a place and credited to your first invoice. Delivery: confirmation on screen and by email as soon as the payment is confirmed; Manthan emails when a place opens. Checkout: https://playbook.asendify.co/obdeposit#buy

## Every feature, by name (last updated 20 October 2026)
- Unlimited email accounts: connect as many sending inboxes as you like, on every plan
- Gmail and Google Workspace: connect with a 16-character app password
- Zoho Mail: connect with an app-specific password, including zoho.eu and zoho.in accounts
- Any IMAP/SMTP inbox: any provider with SSL (SMTP port 465, IMAP port 993)
- Test button: check an inbox's connection from the Email accounts page
- Daily sending limit per inbox: set from 1 to 200 emails a day for each inbox
- Inbox rotation: sends are spread across your inboxes with safe daily limits and natural gaps
- Warm-up network: your inboxes email each other and the network, switched on or off per inbox
- Spam rescue: warm-up emails that land in spam are rescued automatically
- Campaigns: create, start and pause campaigns, each with its own leads, sequence and settings
- Multi-step sequences: add follow-ups and choose how many days after the previous email each one goes out
- Same-thread follow-ups: leave a follow-up subject empty and it is sent as a reply in the same thread
- A/B/C variants: up to 3 versions of each email in a sequence
- Merge fields: {{first_name}}, {{company}}, {{website}} or any column from your CSV
- Fallback values: {{first_name|there}} fills in a default when a field is empty
- Spintax: {Hi|Hey|Hello} picks one option at random for each email
- Sender name and signature: set per inbox; the signature is optional
- Choose the sending inboxes: pick which email accounts send each campaign
- Sending schedule: choose the days, the start and end time and the time zone for each campaign
- Campaign daily cap: a maximum number of new emails per day for the whole campaign
- Stop on reply: the sequence stops for a lead as soon as they reply
- CSV lead upload: upload a CSV with an email column; first name, company, website and other columns become merge fields
- Duplicate skipping: an email address already in the campaign is not added twice
- Email checks: check your list before sending: valid, risky and invalid addresses are counted
- Bounce and unsubscribe handling: bounces and unsubscribes are handled automatically to protect your domain
- AI reply agent: switch it on per campaign to answer interested leads and questions
- Offer facts: the AI may use only the facts you write about your offer: service, price, proof and who it's for
- Booking link: the AI shares your booking link with interested leads
- Reply sorting: every reply is labelled: interested, question, not interested, unsubscribe, out of office or wrong person
- AI drafts: unclear replies are saved as a draft for you to edit before sending
- One inbox for every reply: replies from all your email accounts in one place, with warm-up emails hidden
- Reply from the inbox: answer any reply yourself without leaving the app
- Campaign stats: leads, emails sent, replies, interested leads and bounces for each campaign
- Encrypted app passwords: stored in a secure vault and used only by the sending engine
- 14-day free trial: nothing is charged until day 15
- Flat monthly plans: priced per workspace, not per user; cancel any time and your plan stays on until the end of the month you paid for
- Full list: https://outbound.asendify.co/#all-features

## Who it's for
- For: agencies, consultants and B2B service businesses that book sales calls from cold email; SaaS teams that want replies answered and sorted automatically; anyone sending from several Gmail, Google Workspace, Zoho or IMAP/SMTP inboxes.
- Not for: sending from Outlook / Microsoft 365 (not supported yet); anyone who needs a built-in lead database; teams that need native CRM sync, Zapier, webhooks, a public API or LinkedIn steps today.

## Free tool
- [Cold Email Volume Calculator](https://outbound.asendify.co/cold-email-volume-calculator/): free, plan your sending volume before you start.

## Compared with other tools (list prices, October 2026)
- Instantly: from $47/month; AI Reply Agent paid with credits.
- Smartlead: from $39/month (6,000 emails).
- Lemlist: Email plan $69/month (50,000 emails); Multichannel $109/user/month.
- Saleshandy: Starter $41/month (6,000 emails), Pro $99/month (100,000 emails).
- Reply.io: from $59/user/month; AI SDR from $800/month.
- Mailshake: from $49/user/month with 2 sending addresses.
- Woodpecker: $7 per 100 contacted prospects per month.

## Free tool
- [Cold Email Volume Calculator](https://outbound.asendify.co/cold-email-volume-calculator/): Enter how many cold emails you want to send a month to see the sending inboxes, domains, new leads per month and daily sends you need (defaults: about 30 emails per inbox per day, 22 sending days, 3 inboxes per domain, 3 emails per lead; all adjustable), and which Asendify Outbound plan covers that volume. Free, runs in the browser.
- Who it's for: founders, agencies and sales teams planning a cold email setup.
- More free tools from Asendify: https://www.asendify.co/tools/
